episodeTitle.en: How LinkedIn became interesting: The inside story | Tomer Cohen (CPO at LinkedIn)
episodeTitle.zh: 《领英如何变得引人入胜：内部故事 | 托默·科恩（领英首席产品官）》

guestBioOfficial.en: Tomer Cohen is the chief product officer at LinkedIn, responsible for setting the company’s product strategy, leading product development, user experience design, business development, content creation, and customer operations. He also hosts the Building One podcast, where he interviews exceptional builders across various disciplines. In our conversation, we discuss: • How LinkedIn transformed its feed into an engaging content and social platform
guestBioOfficial.zh:
托默·科恩（Tomer Cohen）是领英的首席产品官，负责制定公司的产品战略、领导产品开发、用户体验设计、业务开发、内容创作和客户运营。他还主持《Building One》播客，采访各领域的杰出创新者。在我们的对话中，我们将探讨：
• 领英如何将其动态推送平台转型为引人入胜的内容和社交平台

title.en: How LinkedIn became interesting: The inside story | Tomer Cohen (CPO at LinkedIn)
title.zh: 《领英如何变得引人入胜：内部故事 | 托默·科恩（领英首席产品官）》

summary.en: Tomer shares how LinkedIn builds product at scale, from revamping the feed to shifting the company toward an AI-first mindset well before it was fashionable. He discusses the structure of product teams, how to keep a massive surface feeling relevant, and lessons from leading one of the world's largest professional networks. The episode is a senior product leader's look at operating at extreme scale.
summary.zh: Tomer 分享了 LinkedIn 如何在规模化下打造产品，从改版信息流，到在该词流行之前很久就推动公司向“AI 优先”转变。他讨论了产品团队的结构、如何让一个庞大的界面始终让人觉得 relevant，以及领导全球最大职业网络之一的经验。本期是一位资深产品领导者对极致规模化运作的透视。
